content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you’re well. Before I sign the agreement, could we adjust a few points?

- The relevant clause currently states that I would be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services without any limit. This could expose me to unlimited financial responsibility. Could we limit liability to an amount not exceeding the total fees paid under the agreement?
- The clause on invoice payment ties the due date to when you receive payment from your own customer, which could delay my receipt indefinitely. I propose that invoices be payable within 15 days of the invoice date, regardless of when you receive payment from your customers.
- Similarly, the payment period is described as 15 days after you are paid by your customer. This creates the same risk of indefinite delay. I suggest wording the payment period as “within 15 days of the Contractor's invoice date.”

Thank you for considering these revisions. I look forward to moving ahead.

Best regards
